description: Returns the complete source code of one UI component for AnimatedWebs Pro accounts: renderer files, shared files and the asset list, with a per-account watermark in the code. Use this to add a component to a project after get_component; non-Pro accounts get an error with the pricing link and can still preview components free. Without path it returns JSON listing every file and includes the code of as many as fit in about 120,000 characters; files that did not fit have no code and are named in omitted, so call again with that path to get one file as plain text (a header line, then the code). New components count toward a fair-use cap per account (40 per 10 minutes, 150 a day, 500 a week, shared with get_background) that never blocks a component already opened today.

id.description: Component id, exactly as returned by search (kind components).

path.description: One file path copied from the files list of a previous call for the same id. Omit to get the overview with as many files as fit; with it the reply is that single file as plain text, not JSON.

name: get_component_source
title: Get UI component source
